researchLog.note: Round 4: FamilySearch supplies birth 12 Nov 1741 Shutesbury and death 8 Dec 1831 Albany; link to Johnny still unproven.
About text rewritten as narrative; the earlier research-note text is kept under Evidence notes.

bio: Sarah Elizabeth Chamberlain was born on 12 November 1741 at Shutesbury, Hampshire County, Massachusetts. She married Matthew Scott, and a Vermont record of their son Jonathan Scott names her as his mother. She died on 8 December 1831 at Albany, New York, and is remembered as Sarah Chamberlain Scott. As with her husband, her place as John's 6th-great-grandmother rests on the still undocumented link through Daniel Scott.

As with her husband Matthew, her place in Johnny's ancestry depends on the undocumented Daniel Scott link.
summary: Massachusetts-born wife of Matthew Scott who died at Albany in 1831; John's 6th-great-grandmother if the Scott line holds.
